title: Ambiguous day preference is recoverable with a second availability lookup
description: The caller starts with a fuzzy Tuesday-or-Wednesday afternoon preference, then corrects the day to Wednesday. The assistant should recover cleanly by issuing a fresh availability lookup instead of freezing the first interpretation.

turns.user: Chcialbym umowic pierwsza konsultacje, najlepiej we wtorek albo srode tak mniej wiecej po lunchu.

rubric.description: The assistant should perform a second availability lookup after the caller corrects the day.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant is not refreshing availability after the caller changes the day preference

rubric.description: The first ambiguous preference should still normalize to the afternoon window.
rubric.root_cause_hint: time preference normalization drifted for phrases such as po lunchu

rubric.description: The corrected Wednesday preference should still normalize to the afternoon window.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant lost the time window when the caller corrected the day

rubric.description: The second availability request should change the requested date after the Wednesday correction.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant ignored the caller correction and kept the stale day selection

rubric.description: This ambiguity-recovery scenario must not create a booking.
rubric.root_cause_hint: assistant advanced into createEvent before the caller selected a concrete slot
